program.section_heading: Level 2 - English as a Second Language for Life Skills
outcomes: Compose written sentences about biographical information, daily life, and work situations with increasing complexity of grammatical form and usage.
Employ basic communication skills and conversation strategies to express personal narratives, career goals, and essential life-skill needs.
Demonstrate the ability to respond to everyday topics and interpret spoken discussions related to occupational settings at a beginning level.

The section was identified as Level 2 because it lists ESL NC 008CE (ESL - II) and ESL NC 050CE (Beginning Conversation) and comes just before the Level 3 section.
